sn22.35:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etdavoca
sn22.35:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu
sn22.35:1.4: yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.35:1.5: yaṃ kho bhikkhu anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati
sn22.35:1.6: yaṃ nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
sn22.35:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn22.35:2.2: rūpañce bhante anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.7: rūpañce bhante nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.8: vedanañce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.11: viññāṇañce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.12: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.35:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.35:3.3: rūpañce bhikkhu anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.8: rūpañce bhikkhu nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.12: viññāṇañce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.13: imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
sn22.35:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn22.35:5.1: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā samma deva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
sn22.35:5.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn22.35:5.3: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
